requirements.existing_evidence: Membership/action folders exist; broad historical eligibility unqualified
requirements.acceptance: Version security IDs, listing/delisting/changes and membership known-at; include historical non-survivors or restrict claims explicitly.

requirements.need: Daily bars, calendar and corporate actions
requirements.existing_evidence: Prices/references exist; selected restricted M0 checks only
requirements.acceptance: Source-bound OHLCV units, sessions, missingness and split/dividend adjustment match independent examples; never adjust executable prices silently.

requirements.existing_evidence: Some source clocks/receipts exist; historical arrivals incomplete
requirements.acceptance: Keep event/acceptance/observed/first-seen/available-at separately; prove historical release clock or label modeled/unknown. New capture cannot fill old receipt gaps.

requirements.need: Causal daily feature engine and package adapter
requirements.existing_evidence: References/features and selected accepted parity exist
requirements.acceptance: Prior-only windows, warmup and prefix/future invariance; independently expected units and accepted version/capability parity. Daily and intraday indicators distinct.

requirements.existing_evidence: Context artifacts exist; applicable clocks/coverage unqualified
requirements.acceptance: Mechanism-specific stock/market alignment and unknown policy; qualified non-ETF measure or explicit missing state; no 18-name market-breadth claim.

requirements.existing_evidence: Trades/TBBO/minute schema evidence exists; full quote-supported fills unqualified
requirements.acceptance: Per instrument/date quote clocks, age, size, spread/status, delay, fees/slippage and fill/censor policy. TBBO is trade-triggered, not continuous quote history.

requirements.need: Funded portfolio and paired scanner/context accounting
requirements.existing_evidence: Synthetic accounting/sleeves exist; full parity/funding open
requirements.acceptance: Original scanner opportunities/weights; veto weights cash; reservations, integer quantities, overlap, dividends, unresolved positions; independent ledger conservation.

requirements.existing_evidence: Historical labels exist but are exposed and isolated
requirements.acceptance: No label I/O before immutable protocol/dependency checks; purge by actual holding/label interval; retain missing/censored/unfilled denominator.

requirements.existing_evidence: Existing experiment/exposure records
requirements.acceptance: Immutable IDs/config/code/input hashes, pre-run timestamp, every attempted variant/failure, selected candidate, access log; final dates null/access disabled.

requirements.existing_evidence: Existing scoped synthetic/math checks; no generic promotion certificate
requirements.acceptance: Paired date/sleeve units, effective support, dependence-aware resampling, economic floor and precision criteria frozen; costs/stress/concentration/multiple-search disclosure.

requirements.existing_evidence: Existing manifests/CI/publication checks
requirements.acceptance: Environment/commands, exact source/input/output identities, sanitized report, all failed runs and explicit scoped acceptance read back from delivered source.

requirements.existing_evidence: 76 archived dossiers; inherited reading/access grades
requirements.acceptance: Trace all versions to their family; distinguish primary read/abstract/secondary/inaccessible, canonical rules vs untested twist, local evidence vs author claims.

requirements.need: Earnings surprise and catalyst vintage ledger
requirements.existing_evidence: Earnings/news/press-release folders; exact consensus vintage unqualified
requirements.acceptance: Pre-release consensus, actual earnings units, publication vs first-seen and revisions; no date-only or hindsight surprise admission.

requirements.existing_evidence: FMP/SEC-related inputs and snapshots; some ex-post
requirements.acceptance: Filing/dissemination, fiscal period, units/restatements and as-of classification; do not substitute report-end date for knowledge time.

requirements.need: Insider identity, transactions and routine/opportunistic history
requirements.existing_evidence: Insider folders exist; complete historical contract unqualified
requirements.acceptance: Issuer/owner IDs, transaction vs filing/arrival, amendments, transaction types and sufficient prior history for frozen routine definition; SEC holdings not Form4 coverage proof.

requirements.existing_evidence: Calendar-related artifacts; exact historical contract unqualified
requirements.acceptance: Timezone/DST/holiday/early-close and schedule-known-at; revisions and canceled events; contemporary event schedule rather than outcome timestamp.

requirements.existing_evidence: OHLCV ingredients; historical pattern efficacy untested
requirements.acceptance: Completed-bar/pivot availability, fixed pattern definition, no future-confirmed zigzag; adequate preregistered rare-event support or blocked/inconclusive.

requirements.need: Options security master, quotes, Greeks and expiry
requirements.existing_evidence: Option artifacts/catalog exist; applicable M3 qualification open
requirements.acceptance: Underlying/OCC ID, strike/expiry/type/multiplier, quotes/sizes/clocks, calculation/IV/Greeks assumptions, exercise/assignment and costs; calls only after supported stock candidate.

requirements.existing_evidence: Trades/TBBO evidence; order-level complete feed not established
requirements.acceptance: Dataset-supported MBO/MBP sequences, order events/queue/venues, receipt latency, cancels and gaps. Cannot infer individual orders from daily bars or trade-direction alone.

requirements.need: Borrow, short inventory and hedge accounting
requirements.existing_evidence: Not qualified for this project
requirements.acceptance: Historical locate/availability/fees, recall/dividends, financing and pair hedge execution; long-only proxy is a distinct hypothesis and scope amendment.

requirements.need: Non-equity instruments, curves, carry and roll history
requirements.existing_evidence: Not qualified in current scope
requirements.acceptance: Instrument calendars/contracts, point-in-time roll/curve/FX/funding/collateral and transaction costs; requires explicit future scope change.

requirements.existing_evidence: Auction feed/rules coverage unqualified
requirements.acceptance: Venue-specific published imbalance clock, auction order/cutoff/cancel rules, auction price/size and contemporaneous eligibility; daily close is not auction-fill proof.

requirements.existing_evidence: Corporate-event folders exist; full historical event coverage unqualified
requirements.acceptance: Announcement/terms/changes/failure/takeover/spinoff eligibility known at decision; include failed events without future takeover selection.

requirements.need: Owner research capital and risk mandate
requirements.existing_evidence: Not selected for funded adoption
requirements.acceptance: Before funded runs specify capital, position/portfolio exposure, acceptable loss/drawdown/turnover and feasible order model; no live mandate implied.
